properties.displayName: UAV S10 - Mobile/Tactical GCS Compromise (Unauthorized Access + Unusual UserAgent)
properties.description: C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List 외부 ClientIp 접속 또는 비정상 UserAgent 패턴(모바일 기기 추정) 탐지. 실제 컬럼: ClientIp, Operator, UserAgent, Action, Result. MITRE: T0864 Transient Cyber Asset, T1550 (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let KnownGCS = _GetWatchlist('C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List') | project GCS_IP;
let ApprovedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Arm_Operator_List') | project OperatorId;
UAVGcsAccess_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| extend isUnknownIp = ClientIp !in (KnownGCS)
| extend isUnknownOp = Operator !in (ApprovedOps)
| extend isFailedAuth = Result != 'success'
| extend isMobileUA = UserAgent has_any ("Mobile", "Android", "iPhone", "iPad") or UserAgent == 'x' or isempty(UserAgent)
| where isUnknownIp or isFailedAuth or isMobileUA
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isUnknownIp and isMobileUA, strcat("비인가IP_모바일UA_동시_", ClientIp),
    isUnknownIp, strcat("GCS_비인가_ClientIp_", ClientIp),
    isFailedAuth, strcat("GCS_인증실패_", Operator),
    strcat("GCS_비정상_UserAgent_", UserAgent))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, SessionId, ClientIp, Operator, UserAgent, Transport, Action, Result, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S10 - Mobile/Tactical GCS Compromise (Unauthorized Access + Unusual UserAgent) - {{ClientIp}}
